programme.title: The Postcard Killings
programme.desc: The New York police officer Jacob Kanon travels to London to visit his newly married daughter. But already at the airport he is stopped by Scotland Yard, who tell him that his daughter and her husband were tasted. The trail goes to a serial mum that sends postcards to local journalists after his act. After the canon identified his daughter's body, he interferes against the will of the British authorities in the murder investigations. / Der New Yorker Polizist Jacob Kanon reist nach London, um dort seine frisch verheiratete Tochter zu besuchen. Doch schon am Flughafen wird er von Scotland Yard gestoppt, die ihm mitteilen, dass seine Tochter und ihr Mann getotet wurden. Die Spur fuhrt zu einem Serienmorder, der nach seiner Tat Postkarten an lokale Journalisten verschickt. Nachdem Kanon die Leiche seiner Tochter identifiziert hat, mischt er sich gegen den Willen der britischen Behorden in die Mordermittlungen ein.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.sub-title: The gentlemen of the ring / Die Herren des Rings
programme.desc: Dr. Leonard Lakey Hofstadter and Dr. Sheldon Cooper are brilliant physicists, work in the same institute and share an apartment. In contrast, Sheldon in particular has its difficulties in dealing with the social environment. To your circle of friends, Dr. Rajesh Ramayan Kothrappali and the engineer Howard Wolowitz. When the Hubsche Penny moves into the apartment next door, she can't do much with the memorable scientists who prefer to spend their free time in the comic bookshop and Halo or World of Warcraft. After a while, however, the group wakes her heart. / Dr. Leonard Leakey Hofstadter und Dr. Sheldon Cooper sind geniale Physiker, arbeiten im selben Institut und teilen sich eine Wohnung. Im Umgang mit der sozialen Umwelt hingegen hat vor allem Sheldon seine Schwierigkeiten. Zu ihrem Freundeskreis gehoren Dr. Rajesh Ramayan Koothrappali und der Ingenieur Howard Wolowitz. Als die hubsche Penny in die Wohnung nebenan einzieht, kann sie zunachst nicht viel mit den merkwurdigen Wissenschaftlern, die ihre Freizeit am liebsten im Comicbuchladen und Halo oder World of Warcraft spielend verbringen, anfangen. Nach einer Weile wachst ihr die Gruppe aber ans Herz.

Österreich wird wahrscheinlich der Steirer Franz-Josef Lasser vertreten, der zwar die groSSten Erfolge im Bahnradsport feiert, aber auch an den StraSSenrennen teilnimmt. Bei der EM 2023 in Rotterdam holte er die Bronzemedaille. StraSSe Herren C5

Die Sportler wollen gemeinsam eine Leidenschaft ausleben und sich gegenseitig zu neuen, auSSergewohnlichen Leistungen anspornen.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Scottish Premiership / Fudbal - Škotski Premiership
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship in its first season has set out in 1890. years and has already been set up by one rarity. Two teams then divided the champion title because of the same number of points at the end of the season. These were today the world-famous Glasgov Rangers, a team with more than 50 championship titles and today a relatively unknown club Dumbarton. The League itself has changed the names and format in a couple of occasions, but since 2013. it is officially called "Scottish Professional Football League" and is the highest scottish football rank. The League is also marked by one of the largest derbies in the history of football between the two Glasgovske teams of Celtic and Rangers. / Škotsko fudbalsko prvenstvo u svoju prvu sezonu su krenuli 1890. godine i već tada je postavljen jedan raritet. Dve ekipe su tada podijelile šampionsku titulu zbog istog broja bodova na kraju sezone. To su bili danas svjetski poznati Glazgov Rendžersi, ekipa sa više od 50 šampionskih titula i danas relativno nepoznati klub Dumbarton. Sama liga je kroz godine u par navrata mijenjala nazive i format, no od 2013. se službeno zove "Scottish Professional Football League" i najviši je rang škotskog fudbala. Ligu isto obilježava jedan od najvećih derbija u istoriji fudbala između dve glazgovske ekipe Seltika i Rendžersa.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Black space / Черно пространство
programme.desc: A video appears in which a person with a unicorn mask turns threatening to everyone: "You think the nightmare is over? Wake up, we see everything. We will not stop until we punish the culprits, we will find you." The students are shaken and frightened. It is clear to investigators, everything is self -violence. Dor's father goes to find his backpack at the school. Detective Davidy does not let him go, but he is surprised that she has disappeared and wants a description. David finds where the video is filmed and takes Morag there. She tells her about the time he studied at the same school and about the incident in which his eye was injured. Itar's father suspects his son for the shooting. Mayan tells Davidy that her boyfriend Reef has made the video and also for the gun. He says they are with Shaul with the "lonely tree". They are arrested. The interrogations are long and heavy. When they understand, Tommy and Shir make a party at the tree. Itamar likes Libby and she knows it. Guy warns her not to play with him. / Появява се видео, в което човек с маска на еднорог се обръща заплашително към всички: "Мислите, че кошмарът е свършил? Събудете се , виждаме всичко. Няма да спрем, докато не накажем виновниците, ще ви намерим." Учениците са втрещени и уплашени. За следователите е ясно, всичко е саморазправа. Бащата на Дор отива да намери в училището раницата му. Детектив Давиди не го пуска, но е учуден, че е изчезнала и иска описание. Давиди открива мястото, където е заснето видеото и завежда там Мораг. Разказва й за времето, когато е учил в същото училище и за инцидента, в който е пострадало окото му. Бащата на Итамар подозира сина си за стрелбата. Маян казва на Давиди, че гаджето й Риф е направил видеото, а също и за пистолета. Казва, че с Шаул са при "самотното дърво". Арестуват ги. Разпитите са дълги и тежки. Когато разбират, Томи и Шир правят парти при дървото. Итамар харесва Либи и тя го знае. Гай я предупреждава да не си играе с него.

Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Lotte - Freiburg, Football, German Cup / Lotte - Freiburg, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cups dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: PAOK - Rijeka, qualifications for the Europa League 2025/2026. / PAOK - Rijeka, Kvalifikacije za Europsku ligu 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) Europa League has a special charm given that this is the most massive competition under the auspices of Uefe. A large number of clubs are included in the qualifying process and the first meetings start at the end of June. This competition is specific because because of its abundance, it also gives "smaller" clubs to feel what it is like to play matches on the European scene. Given that the concentration of strong European clubs is primarily in the Champions League and the local championships in the Europa League, there are big surprises that prove that everyone knows how to play quality football today. Don't miss in these summer months of duel teams you can't follow every day! ... / Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Europa liga ima posebnu draž s obzirom da je to najmasovnije natjecanje pod okriljem UEFE. Velik broj klubova je uključen u proces kvalifikacija te prvi susreti počinju već krajem lipnja. Ovo natjecanje je specifično jer zbog svoje brojnosti daje mogućnost i "manjim" klubovima da osjete kako je to igrati utakmice na europskoj sceni. S obzirom da je koncentracija jakih europskih klubova primarno na Ligi prvaka i domaćim prvenstvima u Europa ligi dolazi do velikih iznenađenja koja dokazuju da danas svatko zna igrati kvalitetan nogomet. Nemojte propustiti u ovim ljetnim mjesecima dvoboje momčadi koje ne možete pratiti svaki dan!...

programme.title: Commissario Laurenti - give everyone their own death / Commissario Laurenti - Gib jedem seinen eigenen Tod
programme.desc: Commissario Laurenti (Henry Hubchen), head of the Trieste criminal police, is stressed: his wife Laura (Barbara Rudnik) absolutely wants to move into a new, quieter apartment, his 18-year daughter Livia (Sophia Thomalla) liked to take part in the will of the Papas for "Miss Triest" and his son Marco (Sergej Moya) uninsured Vespa through the city. When all of this was not enough trouble, a luxury yacht is found on the championship - by the owner, the well -known entrepreneur Bruno de Kopfersberg (Giorgio Basile), there is no trace. De Kopfersberg is not unknown to the Commissario: Years ago Laurenti wanted to overcome the clever business man of the murder of the wife - without success. Now de Kopfersberg himself seems to have been the victim of a crime. Shortly afterwards, a woman's naked body who once worked for him is found. Now the investigation of the Commissario and his assistant Antonio (Florian Panzner) are in full swing. And soon it turns out that the missing person who has the best contacts with rank -high politicians from all over the world is not everything with right things. The Kopfersberg's same as kuhle girlfriend Tatjana Drakic (Claudia Mehnert) and her shady brother Viktor (Aleksandar Jovanovic), who heads the company, seem to be the final characters in this case. Laurenti tracks down a perfidious system of human trafficking, blackmail and corruption: Apparently, the Kopfersberg, which you will soon be murdered out of the sea, will illegally to Italy with Tatjanas and Viktor's help, where they had to serve as a forced prostitute of the high-high EU politicians. The excessive love night in turn secretly photographed the Kopfersberg to blackmail the political bon aus and to clashing for its purposes. But why should Tatjana and Viktor murder their boss and thus the achieved danger? And what does de Kopfersberg's wealthy son Spartaco (David Rott) have to do with the matter? Laurenti taps in the dark - until he has an unexpected hint in the hand, with which he can not only clarify the Bruno de Kopfersberg case, but also a long -lying murder. / Commissario Laurenti (Henry Hubchen), Chef der Triester Kriminalpolizei, ist gestresst: Seine Frau Laura (Barbara Rudnik) will unbedingt in eine neue, ruhigere Wohnung ziehen, seine 18-jahrige Tochter Livia (Sophia Thomalla) mochte gegen den Willen des Papas an der Wahl zur "Miss Triest" teilnehmen und sein Sohn Marco (Sergej Moya) rast mit einer unversicherten Vespa durch die Stadt. Als ware all das nicht schon genug Ärger, wird an der Kuste eine fuhrerlose Luxusyacht gefunden - vom Besitzer, dem bekannten Unternehmer Bruno de Kopfersberg (Giorgio Basile), fehlt jede Spur. De Kopfersberg ist dem Commissario nicht unbekannt: Vor Jahren wollte Laurenti den gewieften Geschaftsmann des Mordes an der Ehefrau uberfuhren - ohne Erfolg. Jetzt scheint de Kopfersberg selbst das Opfer eines Verbrechens geworden zu sein. Kurz darauf wird die nackte Leiche einer Frau gefunden, die einst fur ihn arbeitete. Nun laufen die Ermittlungen des Commissario und seines Assistenten Antonio (Florian Panzner) auf Hochtouren. Und schon bald stellt sich heraus, dass in der Firma des Vermissten, der uber beste Kontakte zu ranghohen Politikern aus aller Welt verfugt, nicht alles mit rechten Dingen zugeht. Laurenti kommt einem perfiden System aus Menschenhandel, Erpressung und Korruption auf die Spur: Offenbar schleuste de Kopfersberg, den man bald ermordet aus dem Meer fischt, mit Tatjanas und Viktors Hilfe junge Osteuropaerinnen illegal nach Italien, wo sie als Zwangsprostituierte ranghohen EU-Politikern zu Diensten stehen mussten. Die ausschweifenden Liebesnachte wiederum lieSS de Kopfersberg heimlich fotografieren, um die Polit-Bonzen erpressen und fur seine Zwecke einspannen zu konnen. Aber warum sollten Tatjana und Viktor ihren Boss ermorden und damit die Geschafte gefahrden? Und was hat de Kopfersbergs wohlstandsverwohnter Sohn Spartaco (David Rott) mit der Sache zu tun? programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Nadia Monning, the wife of a renowned Lubeck cardiac surgeon, shot a burglar in her house. She puts the man with a pistol and wants to understand the police when the burglar can be recognized. It is Nadia's physiotherapist Kai Thieme. At that moment, Nadia's terminally ill father -in -law Horst Monning, who wants to rush to help her. The police called Nadia Monning and says that her father -in -law suffered a cardiac arrest when the burglar was seen. The old man was seriously lung and dependent on an oxygen unit. The new Commissioner Tomke Jenssen arrives at the scene. She is supposed to replace Schroeter in the team, who retired after his serious injury. At the sight of the body, Tomke, who comes from the fraud department in Kiel and has no experience with the dead, becomes almost fainting. But then she makes an important discovery at the scene: there must have been a power failure in the house, because a few watches go 43 minutes. But why didn't anyone notice? And what does the power failure have to do with Horst Monnings's death? / Nadia Monning, die Ehefrau eines renommierten Lubecker Herzchirurgen, uberrascht einen Einbrecher in ihrem Haus. Sie stellt den Mann mit einer Pistole und will die Polizei verstandigen, als sich der Einbrecher zu erkennen gibt. Es ist Nadias Physiotherapeut Kai Thieme. In diesem Moment kommt Nadias todkranker Schwiegervater Horst Monning dazu, der ihr zu Hilfe eilen will.Stunden spater betreten Finn und Lars die Ärztevilla. Nadia Monning hat die Polizei gerufen und sagt aus, ihr Schwiegervater habe beim Anblick des Einbrechers einen Herzstillstand erlitten. Der alte Mann war schwer lungenkrank und von einem Sauerstoffgerat abhangig. Am Tatort trifft die neue Kommissarin Tomke Jenssen ein. Sie soll Schroeter im Team ersetzen, der nach seiner schweren Verletzung in den Ruhestand gegangen ist. Beim Anblick der Leiche wird Tomke, die vom Betrugsdezernat in Kiel kommt und keine Erfahrung mit Toten hat, fast ohnmachtig. Doch dann macht sie am Tatort eine wichtige Entdeckung: Es muss im Haus einen Stromausfall gegeben haben, denn einige Uhren gehen 43 Minuten nach. Aber warum hat das niemand bemerkt? Und was hat der Stromausfall mit dem Tod Horst Monnings zu tun?

Lena Winter gibt sich als frisch berufene Dirndl-Designerin aus und Girwidz vermittelt ihr den GroSSauftrag aus Amerika. programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc: In the Palinger Heide, a jogger fell on the body of the 39-year-old Franziska Hoven. She died on the back of the head after a blow. However, the site is not the scene of the crime. Initial studies show that the dead man was transported in her husband's car, but the husband has been in a coma for weeks after a serious accident, reports the 18-year daughter Lilly Hoven. Finn and Lars review the recordings of the surveillance camera from the Garage of the Hoven family. They clearly show who drove the car on the night of the crime: Lilly's brother Matze. In the commissioner, the interrogation of the alleged tater begins until the lawyer has interrupted the healing. Sebastian Hoven of all people, Matzes Eisigier Zwillingsbruder, represents the suspect. What the two of them then pretend is the most crazed and clogged plan that the investigators and the public prosecutor ever belonged to. If the two get through with it, the murder would remain unpunished. / Eine Joggerin stoSSt in der Palinger Heide auf die Leiche der 39-jahrigen Franziska Hoven. Sie starb an einem Genickbruch nach einem Schlag auf den Hinterkopf. Allerdings ist der Fundort nicht der Tatort. Erste Untersuchungen ergeben, dass die Tote im Wagen ihres Ehemanns transportiert wurde.Doch der Ehemann liegt nach einem schweren Unfall seit Wochen im Koma, berichtet die 18-jahrige Tochter Lilly Hoven. Ihre Stiefmutter Franziska, die Tote, wollte die lebenserhaltenden MaSSnahmen bald einstellen lassen, was nicht nur Lilly sehr emport hat. Finn und Lars uberprufen die Aufnahmen der Überwachungskamera aus der Garage von Familie Hoven. Sie zeigen deutlich, wer das Auto in der Tatnacht gefahren hat: Lillys Bruder Matze. Im Kommissariat beginnt die Vernehmung des mutmaSSlichen Taters, bis dessen Anwalt das Verhor unterbricht. Ausgerechnet Sebastian Hoven, Matzes eineiigier Zwillingsbruder, vertritt den Verdachtigen. Was die beiden dann prasentieren, ist der verruckteste und ausgeklugeltste Plan, den die Ermittler und die Staatsanwaltin je gehort haben. programme.title: Eco Spezial
programme.sub-title: Putin's fleet - Russian espionage in the Baltic Sea / Putins Flotte - russische Spionage in der Ostsee
programme.desc: The fate of Ukraine is being negotiated between the United States, Europe and Russia. The West hopes for peace with sufficient security guarantees for Ukraine. Nevertheless, Russia is not only provoking with massive night drone attacks on Kiev, but also with a war drone that has been lined up by Uber Polish territory. For more than a year, Russia has been testing NATO in the Baltic Sea with ships. Healthy Europe has been vulnerable. Here are the modern lifeline: pipelines, power lines and data cables. If they are destroyed, millions of households could no longer be cared for, and the explosion of the North Stream pipelines three years ago was considered a warning shot. At that time, politicians from all over Europe emphasized the need to better use critical infrastructure. The offshore wind farms, the performance of which should grow enormously in the coming decades, are part of this vital infrastructure. In the nearby pipelines and cables, ships are repeatedly seen under Russian flag that have switched off their location systems and want to remain undetected. You are interested in everything that lies on the sea floor. A whole armada old tanker makes the Baltic Sea unsafe. It is not just about Russian oil, but also about espionage and hybrid war altitude. In the North and Baltic Sea, more than 60 particularly suspicious activities of critical infrastructure could be identified, such as very slow sneak trips and zigzag courses. What is the secret mission of the ships? Why do you drive without position data and have armed special forces on board? And why is it so difficult for the police and militar to act against the mysterious ships? Eco-special from the NDR. Report: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann and Benedikt Strunz. / Das Schicksal der Ukraine wird gerade zwischen den USA, Europa und Russland verhandelt. Der Westen hofft auf einen Frieden mit ausreichenden Sicherheitsgarantien fur die Ukraine. Dennoch provoziert Russland nicht nur mit massiven nachtlichen Drohnenangriffen auf Kiew, sondern unter anderem mit einer Kriegsdrohne, die uber polnischem Staatsgebiet abgesturzt ist. Schon seit mehr als einem Jahr wird von Russland in der Ostsee die Abwehr der NATO mit Schiffen getestet.Verborgen am Meeresgrund ist Europa verwundbar. Hier liegen die modernen Lebensadern: Pipelines, Stromleitungen und Datenkabel. Werden sie zerstort, konnten Millionen Haushalte nicht mehr versorgt werden.Die Explosion der Nord-Stream-Pipelines vor drei Jahren galt vielen als Warnschuss. Politiker aus ganz Europa betonten damals die Notwendigkeit, kritische Infrastruktur musse besser geschutzt werden. Auch die Offshore-Windparks, deren Leistung in den kommenden Jahrzehnten enorm wachsen soll, sind Teil dieser lebenswichtigen Infrastruktur.In der Nahe von Pipelines und Kabeln werden immer wieder Schiffe unter russischer Flagge gesehen, die ihre Ortungssysteme abgeschaltet haben und unentdeckt bleiben wollen. Sie interessieren sich fur all das, was am Meeresboden liegt. Eine ganze Armada alter Tanker macht also die Ostsee unsicher. Es geht dabei nicht nur um russisches Öl, sondern auch um Spionage und hybride Kriegsfuhrung.Der Norddeutsche Rundfunk (NDR) zahlte bei einer Recherche dutzende Durchfahrten. In Nord- und Ostsee konnten auSSerdem mehr als 60 besonders verdachtige Aktivitaten uber kritischer Infrastruktur identifiziert werden, wie etwa ganz langsame Schleichfahrten und Zickzackkurse.Was ist die geheime Mission der Schiffe? Warum fahren sie haufig ohne Positionsdaten und haben bewaffnete Spezialkrafte an Bord? Und wieso fallt es Polizei und Militar so schwer, gegen die mysteriosen Schiffe vorzugehen?ECO-Spezial vom NDR.Bericht: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann und Benedikt Strunz.

Brauchen wir einen Aufstand der Kunstlerinnen und Kunstler, um der Politik innovative Reformen vorzuschlagen, oder haben die Kreativen resigniert und kummern sich nicht mehr um die gesellschaftlichen und politischen Entwicklungen in unserem Land?Dazu bei Patricia Pawlicki bei "3 Am Runden Tisch":Eva Schlegel, Die Bildende Kunstlerin hat mit einer Installation im Parlament den Versuch gestartet, den Blick der Politik auf das Wesentliche zu scharfen,undMartin Kušej, der ehemalige Direktor des Burgtheaters und Intendant des Residenztheaters Munchen hat fur die Buhnen der Welt schon oft Revolutionen inszeniert. programme.title: 3 1/2 hours / 3 1/2 Stunden
programme.desc: In the summer of 1961, the GDR design strengthened its barrier measures. A wall is pulled up between East and West Berlin, windows are barricaded, each loophole is closed. The film is gripping the fateful hours based on a group of GDR burden who want to travel by train from Munchen to East Berlin when they reached the news from the rigid border regime Munchen, August 13, 1961: An interzone train moves towards East Berlin. Nobody still guesses what difficult decision everyone will soon face. The GDR government raises a wall, East Berlin is sealed off. The travelers still have three and a half hours to get out in the west before the Grenzuertrieben. Their decision will have families apart, promising careers dangerous and is not least dependent on the train staff. Edith Salzmann, one of the first locomotives of the GDR, is said to bring the train over the hard border. / Im Sommer 1961 verstarkt die DDR-Fuhrung ihre AbsperrungsmaSSnahmen. Eine Mauer wird zwischen Ost- und Westberlin hochgezogen, Fenster werden verbarrikadiert, jedes Schlupfloch geschlossen. Packend erzahlt der Film die schicksalsentscheidenden Stunden anhand einer Gruppe von DDR-Burgerinnen und Burgern nach, die mit dem Zug von Munchen nach Ost-Berlin reisen wollen, als sie die Nachricht vom rigiden Grenzregime erreicht.Bahnhof Munchen, 13. August 1961: Ein Interzonenzug setzt sich Richtung Ost-Berlin in Bewegung. Noch ahnt niemand, vor welch schwierigen Entscheidung alle bald stehen werden. Die DDR-Regierung zieht eine Mauer hoch, Ost-Berlin wird abgeriegelt. Noch dreieinhalb Stunden haben die Reisenden Zeit, um vor dem Grenzubertritt im Westen auszusteigen. Ihre Entscheidung wird Familien auseinanderreiSSen, vielversprechende Karrieren gefahrden und ist nicht zuletzt vom Zugspersonal abhangig. Edith Salzmann, eine der ersten Lokfuhrerinnen der DDR, soll den Zug uber die harte Grenze bringen.

programme.title: Eco Spezial
programme.sub-title: Putin's fleet - Russian espionage in the Baltic Sea / Putins Flotte - russische Spionage in der Ostsee
programme.desc: The fate of Ukraine is being negotiated between the United States, Europe and Russia. The West hopes for peace with sufficient security guarantees for Ukraine. Nevertheless, Russia is not only provoking with massive night drone attacks on Kiev, but also with a war drone that has been lined up by Uber Polish territory. For more than a year, Russia has been testing NATO in the Baltic Sea with ships. Healthy Europe has been vulnerable. Here are the modern lifeline: pipelines, power lines and data cables. If they are destroyed, millions of households could no longer be cared for, and the explosion of the North Stream pipelines three years ago was considered a warning shot. At that time, politicians from all over Europe emphasized the need to better use critical infrastructure. The offshore wind farms, the performance of which should grow enormously in the coming decades, are part of this vital infrastructure. In the nearby pipelines and cables, ships are repeatedly seen under Russian flag that have switched off their location systems and want to remain undetected. You are interested in everything that lies on the sea floor. A whole armada old tanker makes the Baltic Sea unsafe. It is not just about Russian oil, but also about espionage and hybrid war altitude. In the North and Baltic Sea, more than 60 particularly suspicious activities of critical infrastructure could be identified, such as very slow sneak trips and zigzag courses. What is the secret mission of the ships? Why do you drive without position data and have armed special forces on board? And why is it so difficult for the police and militar to act against the mysterious ships? Eco-special from the NDR. Report: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann and Benedikt Strunz. / Das Schicksal der Ukraine wird gerade zwischen den USA, Europa und Russland verhandelt. Der Westen hofft auf einen Frieden mit ausreichenden Sicherheitsgarantien fur die Ukraine. Dennoch provoziert Russland nicht nur mit massiven nachtlichen Drohnenangriffen auf Kiew, sondern unter anderem mit einer Kriegsdrohne, die uber polnischem Staatsgebiet abgesturzt ist. Schon seit mehr als einem Jahr wird von Russland in der Ostsee die Abwehr der NATO mit Schiffen getestet.Verborgen am Meeresgrund ist Europa verwundbar. Hier liegen die modernen Lebensadern: Pipelines, Stromleitungen und Datenkabel. Werden sie zerstort, konnten Millionen Haushalte nicht mehr versorgt werden.Die Explosion der Nord-Stream-Pipelines vor drei Jahren galt vielen als Warnschuss. Politiker aus ganz Europa betonten damals die Notwendigkeit, kritische Infrastruktur musse besser geschutzt werden. Auch die Offshore-Windparks, deren Leistung in den kommenden Jahrzehnten enorm wachsen soll, sind Teil dieser lebenswichtigen Infrastruktur.In der Nahe von Pipelines und Kabeln werden immer wieder Schiffe unter russischer Flagge gesehen, die ihre Ortungssysteme abgeschaltet haben und unentdeckt bleiben wollen. Sie interessieren sich fur all das, was am Meeresboden liegt. Eine ganze Armada alter Tanker macht also die Ostsee unsicher. Es geht dabei nicht nur um russisches Öl, sondern auch um Spionage und hybride Kriegsfuhrung.Der Norddeutsche Rundfunk (NDR) zahlte bei einer Recherche dutzende Durchfahrten. In Nord- und Ostsee konnten auSSerdem mehr als 60 besonders verdachtige Aktivitaten uber kritischer Infrastruktur identifiziert werden, wie etwa ganz langsame Schleichfahrten und Zickzackkurse.Was ist die geheime Mission der Schiffe? Warum fahren sie haufig ohne Positionsdaten und haben bewaffnete Spezialkrafte an Bord? Und wieso fallt es Polizei und Militar so schwer, gegen die mysteriosen Schiffe vorzugehen?ECO-Spezial vom NDR.Bericht: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann und Benedikt Strunz.

programme.title: The construction of the Berlin Wall - Countdown 61 / Der Bau der Berliner Mauer - Countdown 61
programme.desc: August 13, 1961. In the early hours, the construction of the Berlin Wall begins, which will share Germany for almost 30 years. They tore families and destroyed life. Those who wanted to overcome them risk their life. The construction of the Berlin Wall was preceded by a real countdown, in which Eastern and Westmacht recently opposed in a dramatic nerve test. Even millions of people had been chilled from the GDR to the West. The prehistory of the strictly secret wall is a crime thriller and failed diplomatic tremor. Sandnerlooksfilm, ZDFinfobung: Sabine Assmann / 13.August 1961. In den fruhen Morgenstunden beginnt der Bau der Berliner Mauer, die Deutschland fur fast 30 Jahre teilen wird. Sie zerriss Familien und zerstorte Leben. Wer sie uberwinden wollte, riskierte sein Leben. Dem Bau der Berliner Mauer ging ein regelrechter Countdown voraus, bei dem sich Ost- und Westmachte zuletzt in einer dramatischen Nervenprobe gegenuberstanden. Schon Millionen Menschen waren aus der DDR in den Westen gefluchtet. Die Vorgeschichte des streng geheimen Mauerbaus ist ein Krimi aus Lugen und gescheiterten diplomatischen Bemuhungen.Die "Universum History"-Dokumentation "Der Bau der Berliner Mauer - Countdown 61" von Henrike Sandner beleuchtet das Jahr vor diesem Meilenstein der deutsch-deutschen Geschichte vollig neu - aus der personlichen Perspektive von Zeitzeuginnen und Zeitzeugen.Regie: Henrike SandnerLOOKSfilm, ZDFinfoBearbeitung: Sabine ASSmann

programme.sub-title: Agriculture in change. Does the future of genetic engineering belong? / Landwirtschaft im Wandel. Gehort die Zukunft der Gentechnik?
programme.desc: The use of genetic engineering in agriculture is still controversial after almost 30 years. In addition to environmental concerns and the monopoly position of some fewer seed manufacturers, critics drove the long-term consequences to be tapped. In Europe, many consumers vehemently reject "genetic engineering on the plate". The cultivation of genetically connected plants has been cut in the EU, and in Austria they still have not come to the fields. The large agricultural -producing countries such as the USA, Canada, Brazil or India, on the other hand, rely flatly on it: worldwide generous plants are grown on around 200 million hectares of hectares. Minged into the genome, which means that plants become more resistant to climate extremes and males more resistance and their cultivation is less stressful. For some young farmers it is clear: in the future, agriculture does not have to contradict nature. After a few Durresommern, they were used more resistant NGT corn. But there is worry that in addition to the dependency on seed companies NGT seeds at the end of the day will be too expensive for small farmers. USA correspondent Thomas Langpaul is on local inspection in Oklahoma. The state in the country's central Suden pays to the fuided wheat producers and is one of the hotspots of the American agricultural industry. In addition to wheat, corn, soy and cotton is grown on the huge farms that still rely on classic genetic engineering (GMO). But here too, a rethink begins, because the consequences of climate change - such as extreme dur periods, soil erosion and thus falling streak - also present the large companies with enormous challenges. In 2021, the government dares an experiment: the entire country is to be switched to biological agriculture. Instead of a gradual transition, import and use of synthetic dung agents and pesticides are banned almost over night. Within a few months, the harvesting carrier breaks down drastically, the food prices shoot into the high, protests shocks the country. Correspondent Benedict Feichtner meets peasant families who have lost their livelihood as a result of the abrupt change. In the meantime, imported seeds and chemical sprays have been approved again, but at the same time a kind of countermovement has arisen: in training centers, small farmers learn today how they can sustainably operate organic farming using traditional and regenerative methods and thus escape the dependency on the large seed corporations. / Der Einsatz von Gentechnik in der Landwirtschaft ist - nach inzwischen fast 30 Jahren - immer noch umstritten. Kritiker fuhren neben Umweltbedenken und der Monopolstellung einiger weniger Saatgut-Hersteller vor allem die schwer abzuschatzenden Langzeitfolgen ins Treffen. In Europa lehnen viele Verbraucher "Gentechnik am Teller" vehement ab. Der Anbau gentechnisch veranderter Pflanzen ist in der EU stark eingeschrankt, in Österreich kommen sie bis heute nicht auf die Felder. Die groSSen agrarproduzierenden Lander wie die USA, Kanada, Brasilien oder auch Indien setzen hingegen flachendeckend darauf: weltweit werden auf rund 200 Millionen Hektar genmodifizierte Pflanzen angebaut.In Belgien spricht Korrespondent Johannes Perterer mit Wissenschaftlerinnen, die NGT - also die "Neue Gentechnik" - als groSSe Chance sehen: mit Entwicklungen wie der sogenannten "Genschere" sind prazisere Eingriffe ins Erbgut moglich, wodurch Pflanzen kunftig widerstandsfahiger gegen Klimaextreme und Schadlinge werden und ihr Anbau die Boden weniger belastet. Fur einige junge Bauern steht fest: in Zukunft muss Landwirtschaft nicht im Widerspruch zur Natur stehen. Nach einigen Durresommern wurden sie resistenteren NGT-Mais einsetzen. Doch es bleibt die Sorge, dass neben der Abhangigkeit von Saatgutkonzernen NGT-Saatgut am Ende des Tages fur kleine Bauern zu teuer sein wird.USA-Korrespondent Thomas Langpaul ist auf Lokalaugenschein in Oklahoma unterwegs. Der Bundesstaat im zentralen Suden des Landes zahlt zu den fuhrenden Weizenproduzenten und ist einer der Hotspots der amerikanischen Agrarindustrie. Auf den riesigen Farmen, die nach wie vor auf die klassische Gentechnik (GMO) setzen, wird neben Weizen vor allem Mais, Soja und Baumwolle angebaut. Doch auch hier beginnt ein Umdenken, denn die Folgen des Klimawandels - wie extreme Durreperioden, Bodenerosion und damit sinkende Ertrage - stellen auch die GroSSbetriebe vor enorme Herausforderungen.In Sri Lanka wagt die Regierung 2021 ein Experiment: das gesamte Land soll auf biologische Landwirtschaft umgestellt werden. Anstatt eines schrittweisen Überganges werden Einfuhr und Verwendung synthetischer Dungemittel und Pestizide quasi uber Nacht verboten. Binnen weniger Monate brechen die Ernteertrage drastisch ein, die Lebensmittelpreise schieSSen in die Hohe, Proteste erschuttern das Land. Korrespondent Benedict Feichtner trifft Bauernfamilien, die als Folge des abrupten Umstiegs ihre Existenzgrundlage verloren haben. Inzwischen sind importiertes Saatgut und chemische Spritzmittel wieder zugelassen, doch gleichzeitig ist eine Art Gegenbewegung entstanden: in Schulungszentren lernen Kleinbauern heute, wie sie mit traditionellen und regenerativen Methoden Bio-Landwirtschaft nachhaltig betreiben und so aus der Abhangigkeit von den groSSen Saatgut-Konzernen entkommen konnen.

programme.desc: "As soon as the flies revolve around the soup, the romanticism at the farm catches up," says Tyrolean farmer and actor Tobias Moretti. Teresa Andreae, the designer of the documentary, visited several historical farmers' farm in North and East Tyrol with her team and shows in Austria, picture "Tiroler Bauernhauser - between romanticism and reality" which different forms of continued life are possible. / "Sobald die Fliegen aus dem Stall um die Suppe kreisen, hort sich die Romantik am Bauernhof auf", sagt der Tiroler Bauer und Schauspieler Tobias Moretti. Julia Moretti engagiert sich als Botschafterin fur die "Langenfelder Erklarung", das ist ein Pladoyer fur den Erhalt von landlicher Baukultur. Doch was tut ein aktiver Bauer mit einem alten Hof, der unter Denkmalschutz steht, und der sich mit einem modernen Traktor nur schwer bewirtschaften lasst? Teresa Andreae, die Gestalterin der Dokumentation, hat mit ihrem Team mehrere historische Bauernhofe in Nord- und Osttirol besucht und zeigt im Österreich Bild am Feiertag "Tiroler Bauernhauser - Zwischen Romantik und Realitat" welche unterschiedlichen Formen des Weiterlebens moglich sind.

programme.title: Traumschlosser und Ritterburgen
programme.desc: From Strudengau to the upper Muhlviertel - the castles and locksmith in the Oberosterreiche Danube region are preserved by their owners with foresight for the coming generations.1822 the Saxony -Coburg and Gotha Schloss Greinburg have acquired in Grein an der Donau. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg and Gotha visits the oldest residential castle in Austria several times a month. Further west is the alleged oldest city in Austria: Enns. Parts of the Castle Ennsegg. Just a few kilometers from the state capital Linz, the castle of the same name is located in the municipality of Steygg, on which Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt has headed the forest and estate administration since 2009. Starhemberg Castle has been owned by the Starhemberg family in Eferding west of Linz for around 450 years. Today it houses the family museum and the museum of the city of Eferding, and it is the residence of today's owner Georg Adam Starhemberg. Altenhof Castle in the Upper Muhlviertel once hired as well as the Falkenstein Castle in the immediate vicinity to rule the powerful Falkensteiner. Schloss Altenhof and the Ruin Falkenstein have been owned by the Counts Salburg-Falkenstein for over 400 years. / Vom Strudengau bis ins Obere Muhlviertel - die Burgen und Schlosser in der oberosterreichischen Donauregion werden von ihren Besitzerinnen und Besitzern mit Weitblick fur die kommenden Generationen bewahrt.1822 hat die Familie Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha Schloss Greinburg in Grein an der Donau erworben. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha besucht das alteste Wohnschloss Österreichs mehrmals im Monat. Weiter westlich befindet sich die vorgeblich alteste Stadt Österreichs: Enns. Als Teil der Stadtbefestigung dienten einst Teile der Anlage von Schloss Ennsegg. Nur wenige Kilometer von der Landeshauptstadt Linz entfernt befindet sich in der Stadtgemeinde Steyregg das gleichnamige Schloss, auf dem Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt seit 2009 die Forst- und Gutsverwaltung leitet. Seit rund 450 Jahren ist Schloss Starhemberg in Eferding westlich von Linz im Besitz der furstlichen Familie Starhemberg. Heute beherbergt es das Familienmuseum, sowie das Museum der Stadt Eferding, und es ist der Wohnsitz des heutigen Besitzers Georg Adam Starhemberg. Schloss Altenhof im Oberen Muhlviertel gehorte einst wie auch die in der unmittelbaren Umgebung gelegene Burg Falkenstein zur Herrschaft der machtigen Falkensteiner. Seit uber 400 Jahren sind Schloss Altenhof und die Ruine Falkenstein im Besitz der Grafen Salburg-Falkenstein.

programme.title: Seiji Ozawa - back in Japan / Seiji Ozawa - Zuruck in Japan
programme.desc: Born in 1935, Seiji Ozawa was an outstanding artist's personality until his death in February 2024 that never met the cliché of a "classic" musician. Ozawa learned from Leonard Bernstein and Herbert von Karajan and was the first Asian to head a large western orchestra: the renowned Boston Symphony Orchestra, at the top of which he was supposed to stand for almost 30 years. The Japanese conductor made the orchestra from Boston one of the most found ensembles of North America. After a serious illness, Seiji Ozawa, who was music director of the Vienna State Opera from 2002 to 2010, finally finally returned to Japan. There he was primarily concerned with the demand for young musicians, whom he wanted to convey his love for music. Director Olivier Simonnet accompanied Ozawa in Japan for almost two years. In the portrait, Seiji Ozawa speaks about Asia, the discovery of the western repertoire in Japan, large composers and of course about the transfer of his can. His split relationship to his home country also becomes clear: the musician, who was celebrated as a national hero, was earlier an outsider who tackled his claims and his love of freedom. / 1935 geboren, war Seiji Ozawa bis zu seinem Tod im Februar 2024 eine herausragende Kunstlerpersonlichkeit, die nie dem Klischee eines "klassischen" Musikers entsprach. Ozawa lernte bei Leonard Bernstein und Herbert von Karajan und leitete als erster Asiate ein groSSes westliches Orchester: das renommierte Boston Symphony Orchestra, an dessen Spitze er nahezu 30 Jahre lang stehen sollte. Der japanische Dirigent machte das Orchester aus Boston zu einem der beruhmtesten Ensembles Nordamerikas.Nach einer schweren Erkrankung kehrte Seiji Ozawa, der von 2002 bis 2010 Musikdirektor der Wiener Staatsoper war, schlieSSlich endgultig nach Japan zuruck. Dort bemuhte er sich vor allem um die Forderung von jungen Nachwuchsmusikern, denen er seine Liebe zur Musik vermitteln wollte.Regisseur Olivier Simonnet begleitete Ozawa fast zwei Jahre lang in Japan. In dem Portrait spricht Seiji Ozawa uber Asien, die Entdeckung des westlichen Repertoires in Japan, groSSe Komponisten und naturlich uber die Weitergabe seines Konnens. Dabei wird auch sein gespaltenes Verhaltnis zu seinem Heimatland deutlich: Der Musiker, der als Nationalheld gefeiert wurde, war fruher ein Outsider, der mit seinen Anspruchen und seiner Freiheitsliebe aneckte.

programme.title: Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers
programme.sub-title: From the Puszta to the Adriatic / Von der Puszta an die Adria
programme.desc: The five of the successful series "On the rails of the double -headed eagle" by Bjorn Kolz and Gernot Stadler takes the viewer on a cinematic journey into the Hungarian imperial monster of the former Danube monarchy.*The Hungarian lanes with their train station, bridges and viaducts are both architecturally and cultural -historically. They achieved their importance as a connection between the Eastern and Western European economic areas with the Balkans.*Once there was a country, from whose sky sun, crescent moon and Davidstern, a realm, as far as the flight of the Habsburg dual eagle. What remained have remained memories of a time that has been forgiven for their mistakes and which is called the "good old". And they are rail streets that have remained. Iron Bander, laid on thousands of kilometers between swamps and gorges, steppe and sea. They once kept together an empire in the heart of Europe: Austria-Hungary. The starting point of the cinematic journey is Budapest with its elaborated Bahnhofen, the Keleti and the Nyugati train station, two magnificent cathedrals of the railway age. Georg Habsburg runs through Budapest, where his grandfather Karl was crowned for the last king of Hungary and accompanies us to Godollo, the favorite castle of Konigin Elisabeth. A visit to the largest railway museum in Europe, the Budapest locomotive park, as little as a ride with a historic steam train on the oldest railway line in Hungary. The same as the railway network in the Hungarian empire wasted from Budapest from a star form, and also follows the old train lines according to Temesvar in today's Rumania, to "Banmering" With its numerous browns and tunnels, to the forest railways in Sudwesten in Hungary or to Croatia, where the so -called "Hungarian Riviera" attracted numerous nobles, artists and burger year for year. The port city of Fiume, today's Rijeka, competed with the Easter Reiche harbor and still testify to many buildings in the old town or the old shipyards from the former glory of Rijeka at the time of the Habsburg. "On the rails of the double eagle - from the Puszta to the Adriatic" is a cinematic journey through the times and to be removed from the former. Austria-Hungary, which was held together not least by his more than 46,000 kilometer railway network until his demise. / Der funfte Teil der Erfolgsserie "Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers" von Bjorn Kolz und Gernot Stadler nimmt den Zuseher mit auf eine filmische Reise in die ungarische Reichshalfte der ehemaligen Donaumonarchie.*Die ungarischen Bahnen mit ihren Bahnhofen, Brucken und Viadukten gelten sowohl architektonisch als auch kulturgeschichtlich als Leistung ersten Ranges. Ihre Bedeutung erlangten sie als Verbindung zwischen den ost- und westeuropaischen Wirtschaftsraumen mit dem Balkan.*Es war einmal ein Land, von dessen Himmel Sonne, Halbmond und Davidstern friedlich vereint herabfunkelten, ein Reich, so weit wie die Flugelspannen des habsburgischen Doppeladlers. Geblieben sind Erinnerungen an eine Zeit, der man ihre Fehler langst verziehen hat und die man die "gute alte" nennt. Und es sind Schienenstrange, die geblieben sind. Eiserne Bander, verlegt auf tausenden Kilometern zwischen Sumpfen und Schluchten, Steppe und Meer. Einst hielten sie ein Reich im Herzen Europas zusammen: Österreich-Ungarn.Ausgangspunkt der filmischen Reise ist Budapest mit seinen beruhmten Bahnhofen, dem Keleti und dem Nyugati-Bahnhof, zwei prachtvollen Kathedralen des Eisenbahnzeitalters. Georg Habsburg fuhrt durch Budapest, wo sein GroSSvater Karl zum letzten Konig von Ungarn gekront wurde und begleitet uns nach Godollo, dem Lieblingsschloss von Konigin Elisabeth. Ein Besuch im groSSten Eisenbahnmuseum Europas, dem Lokpark von Budapest fehlt ebenso wenig, wie eine Fahrt mit einem historischen Dampfzug auf der altesten Bahnlinie Ungarns.So wie sich das Eisenbahnnetz in der ungarischen Reichshalfte von Budapest aus sternformig verzweigte und in alle Himmelrichtungen fuhrte, folgt auch die Dokumentation den alten Bahnlinien nach Temesvar im heutigen Rumanien, zum "Banater Semmering" mit seinen zahlreichen Brucken und Tunnels, zu den Waldbahnen im Sudwesten Ungarns oder nach Kroatien, wo die sogenannte "ungarische Riviera" Jahr fur Jahr zahlreiche Adelige, Kunstler und Burger anlockte. Die Hafenstadt Fiume, das heutige Rijeka, machte dem osterreichischen Hafen Triest Konkurrenz und auch jetzt noch zeugen viele Gebaude in der Altstadt oder die alten Werftanlagen vom einstigen Glanz Rijekas zur Zeit der Habsburger."Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers - Von der Puszta an die Adria" ist eine filmische Reise durch die Zeiten und zu entlegenen Winkeln des einstigen Vielvolkerstaates Österreich-Ungarn, der bis zu seinem Untergang nicht zuletzt von seinem mehr als 46.000 Kilometer langen Eisenbahnnetz zusammengehalten wurde.Eine Dokumentation von Gernot Stadler und Bjorn Kolz

programme.title: Traumschlosser und Ritterburgen
programme.desc: From Strudengau to the upper Muhlviertel - the castles and locksmith in the Oberosterreiche Danube region are preserved by their owners with foresight for the coming generations.1822 the Saxony -Coburg and Gotha Schloss Greinburg have acquired in Grein an der Donau. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg and Gotha visits the oldest residential castle in Austria several times a month. Further west is the alleged oldest city in Austria: Enns. Parts of the Castle Ennsegg. Just a few kilometers from the state capital Linz, the castle of the same name is located in the municipality of Steygg, on which Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt has headed the forest and estate administration since 2009. Starhemberg Castle has been owned by the Starhemberg family in Eferding west of Linz for around 450 years. Today it houses the family museum and the museum of the city of Eferding, and it is the residence of today's owner Georg Adam Starhemberg. Altenhof Castle in the Upper Muhlviertel once hired as well as the Falkenstein Castle in the immediate vicinity to rule the powerful Falkensteiner. Schloss Altenhof and the Ruin Falkenstein have been owned by the Counts Salburg-Falkenstein for over 400 years. / Vom Strudengau bis ins Obere Muhlviertel - die Burgen und Schlosser in der oberosterreichischen Donauregion werden von ihren Besitzerinnen und Besitzern mit Weitblick fur die kommenden Generationen bewahrt.1822 hat die Familie Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha Schloss Greinburg in Grein an der Donau erworben. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha besucht das alteste Wohnschloss Österreichs mehrmals im Monat. Weiter westlich befindet sich die vorgeblich alteste Stadt Österreichs: Enns. Als Teil der Stadtbefestigung dienten einst Teile der Anlage von Schloss Ennsegg. Nur wenige Kilometer von der Landeshauptstadt Linz entfernt befindet sich in der Stadtgemeinde Steyregg das gleichnamige Schloss, auf dem Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt seit 2009 die Forst- und Gutsverwaltung leitet. Seit rund 450 Jahren ist Schloss Starhemberg in Eferding westlich von Linz im Besitz der furstlichen Familie Starhemberg. Heute beherbergt es das Familienmuseum, sowie das Museum der Stadt Eferding, und es ist der Wohnsitz des heutigen Besitzers Georg Adam Starhemberg. programme.title: Seiji Ozawa - back in Japan / Seiji Ozawa - Zuruck in Japan
programme.desc: Born in 1935, Seiji Ozawa was an outstanding artist's personality until his death in February 2024 that never met the cliché of a "classic" musician. Ozawa learned from Leonard Bernstein and Herbert von Karajan and was the first Asian to head a large western orchestra: the renowned Boston Symphony Orchestra, at the top of which he was supposed to stand for almost 30 years. The Japanese conductor made the orchestra from Boston one of the most found ensembles of North America. After a serious illness, Seiji Ozawa, who was music director of the Vienna State Opera from 2002 to 2010, finally finally returned to Japan. There he was primarily concerned with the demand for young musicians, whom he wanted to convey his love for music. Director Olivier Simonnet accompanied Ozawa in Japan for almost two years. In the portrait, Seiji Ozawa speaks about Asia, the discovery of the western repertoire in Japan, large composers and of course about the transfer of his can. His split relationship to his home country also becomes clear: the musician, who was celebrated as a national hero, was earlier an outsider who tackled his claims and his love of freedom. / 1935 geboren, war Seiji Ozawa bis zu seinem Tod im Februar 2024 eine herausragende Kunstlerpersonlichkeit, die nie dem Klischee eines "klassischen" Musikers entsprach. Ozawa lernte bei Leonard Bernstein und Herbert von Karajan und leitete als erster Asiate ein groSSes westliches Orchester: das renommierte Boston Symphony Orchestra, an dessen Spitze er nahezu 30 Jahre lang stehen sollte. Der japanische Dirigent machte das Orchester aus Boston zu einem der beruhmtesten Ensembles Nordamerikas.Nach einer schweren Erkrankung kehrte Seiji Ozawa, der von 2002 bis 2010 Musikdirektor der Wiener Staatsoper war, schlieSSlich endgultig nach Japan zuruck. Dort bemuhte er sich vor allem um die Forderung von jungen Nachwuchsmusikern, denen er seine Liebe zur Musik vermitteln wollte.Regisseur Olivier Simonnet begleitete Ozawa fast zwei Jahre lang in Japan. In dem Portrait spricht Seiji Ozawa uber Asien, die Entdeckung des westlichen Repertoires in Japan, groSSe Komponisten und naturlich uber die Weitergabe seines Konnens. Dabei wird auch sein gespaltenes Verhaltnis zu seinem Heimatland deutlich: Der Musiker, der als Nationalheld gefeiert wurde, war fruher ein Outsider, der mit seinen Anspruchen und seiner Freiheitsliebe aneckte.

programme.title: WeltWeit
programme.sub-title: Agriculture in change. Does the future of genetic engineering belong? / Landwirtschaft im Wandel. Gehort die Zukunft der Gentechnik?
programme.desc: The use of genetic engineering in agriculture is still controversial after almost 30 years. In addition to environmental concerns and the monopoly position of some fewer seed manufacturers, critics drove the long-term consequences to be tapped. In Europe, many consumers vehemently reject "genetic engineering on the plate". The cultivation of genetically connected plants has been cut in the EU, and in Austria they still have not come to the fields. The large agricultural -producing countries such as the USA, Canada, Brazil or India, on the other hand, rely flatly on it: worldwide generous plants are grown on around 200 million hectares of hectares. Minged into the genome, which means that plants become more resistant to climate extremes and males more resistance and their cultivation is less stressful. For some young farmers it is clear: in the future, agriculture does not have to contradict nature. After a few Durresommern, they were used more resistant NGT corn. But there is worry that in addition to the dependency on seed companies NGT seeds at the end of the day will be too expensive for small farmers. USA correspondent Thomas Langpaul is on local inspection in Oklahoma. The state in the country's central Suden pays to the fuided wheat producers and is one of the hotspots of the American agricultural industry. In addition to wheat, corn, soy and cotton is grown on the huge farms that still rely on classic genetic engineering (GMO). But here too, a rethink begins, because the consequences of climate change - such as extreme dur periods, soil erosion and thus falling streak - also present the large companies with enormous challenges. In 2021, the government dares an experiment: the entire country is to be switched to biological agriculture. Instead of a gradual transition, import and use of synthetic dung agents and pesticides are banned almost over night. Within a few months, the harvesting carrier breaks down drastically, the food prices shoot into the high, protests shocks the country. Correspondent Benedict Feichtner meets peasant families who have lost their livelihood as a result of the abrupt change. In the meantime, imported seeds and chemical sprays have been approved again, but at the same time a kind of countermovement has arisen: in training centers, small farmers learn today how they can sustainably operate organic farming using traditional and regenerative methods and thus escape the dependency on the large seed corporations. / Der Einsatz von Gentechnik in der Landwirtschaft ist - nach inzwischen fast 30 Jahren - immer noch umstritten. Kritiker fuhren neben Umweltbedenken und der Monopolstellung einiger weniger Saatgut-Hersteller vor allem die schwer abzuschatzenden Langzeitfolgen ins Treffen. In Europa lehnen viele Verbraucher "Gentechnik am Teller" vehement ab. Der Anbau gentechnisch veranderter Pflanzen ist in der EU stark eingeschrankt, in Österreich kommen sie bis heute nicht auf die Felder. Die groSSen agrarproduzierenden Lander wie die USA, Kanada, Brasilien oder auch Indien setzen hingegen flachendeckend darauf: weltweit werden auf rund 200 Millionen Hektar genmodifizierte Pflanzen angebaut.In Belgien spricht Korrespondent Johannes Perterer mit Wissenschaftlerinnen, die NGT - also die "Neue Gentechnik" - als groSSe Chance sehen: mit Entwicklungen wie der sogenannten "Genschere" sind prazisere Eingriffe ins Erbgut moglich, wodurch Pflanzen kunftig widerstandsfahiger gegen Klimaextreme und Schadlinge werden und ihr Anbau die Boden weniger belastet. Fur einige junge Bauern steht fest: in Zukunft muss Landwirtschaft nicht im Widerspruch zur Natur stehen. Nach einigen Durresommern wurden sie resistenteren NGT-Mais einsetzen. Doch es bleibt die Sorge, dass neben der Abhangigkeit von Saatgutkonzernen NGT-Saatgut am Ende des Tages fur kleine Bauern zu teuer sein wird.USA-Korrespondent Thomas Langpaul ist auf Lokalaugenschein in Oklahoma unterwegs. Der Bundesstaat im zentralen Suden des Landes zahlt zu den fuhrenden Weizenproduzenten und ist einer der Hotspots der amerikanischen Agrarindustrie. Auf den riesigen Farmen, die nach wie vor auf die klassische Gentechnik (GMO) setzen, wird neben Weizen vor allem Mais, Soja und Baumwolle angebaut. Doch auch hier beginnt ein Umdenken, denn die Folgen des Klimawandels - wie extreme Durreperioden, Bodenerosion und damit sinkende Ertrage - stellen auch die GroSSbetriebe vor enorme Herausforderungen.In Sri Lanka wagt die Regierung 2021 ein Experiment: das gesamte Land soll auf biologische Landwirtschaft umgestellt werden. Anstatt eines schrittweisen Überganges werden Einfuhr und Verwendung synthetischer Dungemittel und Pestizide quasi uber Nacht verboten. Binnen weniger Monate brechen die Ernteertrage drastisch ein, die Lebensmittelpreise schieSSen in die Hohe, Proteste erschuttern das Land. Korrespondent Benedict Feichtner trifft Bauernfamilien, die als Folge des abrupten Umstiegs ihre Existenzgrundlage verloren haben. Inzwischen sind importiertes Saatgut und chemische Spritzmittel wieder zugelassen, doch gleichzeitig ist eine Art Gegenbewegung entstanden: in Schulungszentren lernen Kleinbauern heute, wie sie mit traditionellen und regenerativen Methoden Bio-Landwirtschaft nachhaltig betreiben und so aus der Abhangigkeit von den groSSen Saatgut-Konzernen entkommen konnen.

programme.title: Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers
programme.sub-title: From the Puszta to the Adriatic / Von der Puszta an die Adria
programme.desc: The five of the successful series "On the rails of the double -headed eagle" by Bjorn Kolz and Gernot Stadler takes the viewer on a cinematic journey into the Hungarian imperial monster of the former Danube monarchy.*The Hungarian lanes with their train station, bridges and viaducts are both architecturally and cultural -historically. They achieved their importance as a connection between the Eastern and Western European economic areas with the Balkans.*Once there was a country, from whose sky sun, crescent moon and Davidstern, a realm, as far as the flight of the Habsburg dual eagle. What remained have remained memories of a time that has been forgiven for their mistakes and which is called the "good old". And they are rail streets that have remained. Iron Bander, laid on thousands of kilometers between swamps and gorges, steppe and sea. They once kept together an empire in the heart of Europe: Austria-Hungary. The starting point of the cinematic journey is Budapest with its elaborated Bahnhofen, the Keleti and the Nyugati train station, two magnificent cathedrals of the railway age. Georg Habsburg runs through Budapest, where his grandfather Karl was crowned for the last king of Hungary and accompanies us to Godollo, the favorite castle of Konigin Elisabeth. A visit to the largest railway museum in Europe, the Budapest locomotive park, as little as a ride with a historic steam train on the oldest railway line in Hungary. The same as the railway network in the Hungarian empire wasted from Budapest from a star form, and also follows the old train lines according to Temesvar in today's Rumania, to "Banmering" With its numerous browns and tunnels, to the forest railways in Sudwesten in Hungary or to Croatia, where the so -called "Hungarian Riviera" attracted numerous nobles, artists and burger year for year. The port city of Fiume, today's Rijeka, competed with the Easter Reiche harbor and still testify to many buildings in the old town or the old shipyards from the former glory of Rijeka at the time of the Habsburg. "On the rails of the double eagle - from the Puszta to the Adriatic" is a cinematic journey through the times and to be removed from the former. Austria-Hungary, which was held together not least by his more than 46,000 kilometer railway network until his demise. / Der funfte Teil der Erfolgsserie "Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers" von Bjorn Kolz und Gernot Stadler nimmt den Zuseher mit auf eine filmische Reise in die ungarische Reichshalfte der ehemaligen Donaumonarchie.*Die ungarischen Bahnen mit ihren Bahnhofen, Brucken und Viadukten gelten sowohl architektonisch als auch kulturgeschichtlich als Leistung ersten Ranges. Ihre Bedeutung erlangten sie als Verbindung zwischen den ost- und westeuropaischen Wirtschaftsraumen mit dem Balkan.*Es war einmal ein Land, von dessen Himmel Sonne, Halbmond und Davidstern friedlich vereint herabfunkelten, ein Reich, so weit wie die Flugelspannen des habsburgischen Doppeladlers. Geblieben sind Erinnerungen an eine Zeit, der man ihre Fehler langst verziehen hat und die man die "gute alte" nennt. Und es sind Schienenstrange, die geblieben sind. Eiserne Bander, verlegt auf tausenden Kilometern zwischen Sumpfen und Schluchten, Steppe und Meer. Einst hielten sie ein Reich im Herzen Europas zusammen: Österreich-Ungarn.Ausgangspunkt der filmischen Reise ist Budapest mit seinen beruhmten Bahnhofen, dem Keleti und dem Nyugati-Bahnhof, zwei prachtvollen Kathedralen des Eisenbahnzeitalters. Georg Habsburg fuhrt durch Budapest, wo sein GroSSvater Karl zum letzten Konig von Ungarn gekront wurde und begleitet uns nach Godollo, dem Lieblingsschloss von Konigin Elisabeth. Ein Besuch im groSSten Eisenbahnmuseum Europas, dem Lokpark von Budapest fehlt ebenso wenig, wie eine Fahrt mit einem historischen Dampfzug auf der altesten Bahnlinie Ungarns.So wie sich das Eisenbahnnetz in der ungarischen Reichshalfte von Budapest aus sternformig verzweigte und in alle Himmelrichtungen fuhrte, folgt auch die Dokumentation den alten Bahnlinien nach Temesvar im heutigen Rumanien, zum "Banater Semmering" mit seinen zahlreichen Brucken und Tunnels, zu den Waldbahnen im Sudwesten Ungarns oder nach Kroatien, wo die sogenannte "ungarische Riviera" Jahr fur Jahr zahlreiche Adelige, Kunstler und Burger anlockte. Die Hafenstadt Fiume, das heutige Rijeka, machte dem osterreichischen Hafen Triest Konkurrenz und auch jetzt noch zeugen viele Gebaude in der Altstadt oder die alten Werftanlagen vom einstigen Glanz Rijekas zur Zeit der Habsburger."Auf den Schienen des Doppeladlers - Von der Puszta an die Adria" ist eine filmische Reise durch die Zeiten und zu entlegenen Winkeln des einstigen Vielvolkerstaates Österreich-Ungarn, der bis zu seinem Untergang nicht zuletzt von seinem mehr als 46.000 Kilometer langen Eisenbahnnetz zusammengehalten wurde.Eine Dokumentation von Gernot Stadler und Bjorn Kolz
